text: At its meeting on July 19, 20, 21 and 22, 2022, City Council adopted Item TE34.35, in connection with a site-specific zoning amendment relating to redevelopment of lands at 200 Queens Quay. The application was approved for a mixed-use development and included an on-site parkland dedication having a minimum area of 488 square metres as contemplated by Section 42 of the Planning Act. The proposed development was approved and site- specific By-law 1012-2022 was enacted by Council which secured the parkland conveyance as a matter in support of the development through Section 37 Agreement requirements.
